maintenanceRequests.title: High Pressure Water Line Leakage in Kitchen Riser
maintenanceRequests.description: Resident reported persistent acoustic humming and slight water seepage near main kitchen water supply valve beneath sink cabinet. Pressure regulator requires diaphragm gasket check.

maintenanceRequests.title: Sub-panel Circuit Breaker Intermittent Tripping
maintenanceRequests.description: Master bedroom RCCB 32A trips when HVAC and water heater operate concurrently. Load balancing test and wire insulation resistance check needed.

maintenanceRequests.title: Central Promenade Fountain Water Filter Service
maintenanceRequests.description: Bio-filtration cartridges clogged with autumn organic matter. Water clarity index dropped below threshold. Recirculation impellers require flushing.

maintenanceRequests.title: Traction Elevator Passenger Car Door Optical Sensor Malfunction
maintenanceRequests.description: Car Door #2 exhibits false obstruction detection on ground floor lobby, resulting in delayed cycle closing. Optical curtain sensor alignment in progress.

maintenanceRequests.title: Underground Booster Pump Stage-2 Contactor Chatter
maintenanceRequests.description: Primary booster pump motor contactor emits loud 50Hz hum and sparks upon automated pressure drop trigger. Needs immediate replacement to avoid pump burnout.

maintenanceRequests.title: Exterior Corridor Acoustic Ceiling Plaster Peeling
maintenanceRequests.description: Post-monsoon micro-seepage led to 4 sq.m of primer blister on East corridor soffit. Scraping, sealing with moisture epoxy, and touch-up required.

maintenanceRequests.title: Master Bathroom Shower Mixer Thermostatic Valve Stiff
maintenanceRequests.description: Grohe thermostatic mixing cartridge stiff to rotate past 38°C mark. Descaling or cartridge core replacement required.

maintenanceRequests.title: Waterfront Promenade Jogging Track Timber Handrail Splintering
maintenanceRequests.description: Salt mist exposure degraded teak finish along a 15-meter promenade stretch. Sanding, rounding edges, and applying marine polyurethane sealer needed.

maintenanceRequests.title: Balcony Drainage Pipe Siphoning Odor
maintenanceRequests.description: Dry P-trap on exterior balcony drain allows back-drafting odors during strong coastal sea breezes. Needs anti-siphon valve installation.

maintenanceRequests.title: Clubhouse Infinity Pool Surrounds Deep Cleaning & Descaling
maintenanceRequests.description: Non-slip pool deck travertine tile washed with pH-neutral stone cleaner. Mineral scale removed around infinity overflow channel.
